name: pdlc
description: Bootstrap a new or existing project for the praxis development lifecycle — plant the always-on PDLC grounding (CLAUDE.md), wire the .handoff/ transport, opt into the peer utilities (Backlog.md, Spec Kit) — orchestrate multi-task board sweeps through that lifecycle: pdlc:sweep authors a dependency-laned, operator-signed-off runbook, then runs every task through spec, PR, merge, and re-ground; pdlc:design-rounds covers the inverse case, where the deliverable is not knowable until an operator has chosen among options, running comparable design rounds to a decision record and a spec written against it — and close the loop with pdlc:refactor-triage, which triages the swept result for debt and drift and cards accepted findings back onto the board as sweepable tasks.
